$comment: Tests known to fail on main, so a gate can tell a new failure from an old one without rebuilding main.
Matched by spec file + title (describe titles joined with ' › '); line is informational and drifts.
Add an entry only after running the test on an untouched main, and record that commit in verifiedOn.
`node scripts/e2e-affected.mjs compare <report>` names entries that pass: re-verify on main and remove them.

project-team-setup.spec.ts fails a different subset per run (6 of 8 at four workers in the full run, 7 of 8 with the file alone at one), so all eight are listed with intermittent: true — a pass of one is not a fix.

Checked 2026-10-04 at dad4726ba and NOT listed because they passed: ledger 111/115's six (coding-session-founder-acts:380, coding-session-observations:33/114/144, coding-sessions:458, project-packs:40) and the dense-history case (channel-dense-second-reach:28).

The baseline came from three four-worker full runs; a fourth may find more. An intermittent entry is a blind spot: a real regression in that test is reported as known. project-team-setup.spec.ts is wholly blind this way — every test in it is listed — so a change that reaches that file must be checked by hand (run it alone at E2E_WORKERS=1 and read the failures).
